title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Disputes Desk Rules — Filing and Resolving Invoice Disputes
content:
## Filing

An invoice dispute on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account — for a wrong price, a wrong quantity, merchandise not received or an unauthorized buyer — is filed as an invoice dispute request naming the disputed invoice and the disputed amount.

It is accepted only when the dispute is filed no more than the tier's dispute filing window, in calendar days, after the invoice date. Days are counted as calendar days from the invoice date as day 0 to the date the dispute is filed; filing on the last day is timely. The invoice date is that of the invoice record and the filing date is the date the request was created.

Hypothetical pair on a 45-day tier, invoice dated 10 January: day 45 falls on 24 February, so a dispute filed on 24 February is timely and one filed on 25 February is not.

## While the dispute is open

It is resolved within the tier's maximum dispute resolution days. While it is open, the disputed amount is left out of the past-due balance and of hold decisions where the tier holds disputed invoices out of late charges, and the undisputed part of the invoice remains due on its due date.

Hypothetical example: on an invoice of 2400.00 with 600.00 disputed, 1800.00 remains due on the invoice's due date while the dispute is open.

## Decision and credit

- A dispute credit posts only when the invoice dispute request has status approved.
- **Retired, no longer in force:** the clause that the dispute credit credits the disputed amount against the invoice, referencing the invoice and the request, has been superseded by the current Ridgeline Pro Credit basis for dispute settlement credits.
- A pricing dispute on an invoice priced under a ProBuild volume pricing quote is decided against the quoted prices of the referenced ProBuild quote, not shelf prices.
- One invoice receives at most one dispute credit, as shown by the dispute credits already referencing it.

superseded_clauses: it credits the disputed amount against the invoice, referencing the invoice row and the request.
